title: Investigate a SOAR-to-ServiceNow Automation Failure
objectives: Demonstrate actual outcomes and independently inspect evidence.

tasks.instruction: Open Interview workbench → Recorded security operations. The fixture has a real authentication notable and a failed offline response using training_expired. Inspect the retained authentication error and confirm no ticket was created.

Review and save the fictional response adapter with version: 1, endpoint: https://servicenow.practice.invalid, credentialAlias: training_valid, allowed: true. Run the same notable’s response twice; one ticket must be created and the retry must return existing. Assign/investigate the notable with an evidence note. Preserve the original failure. These aliases and receipts model the handoff; no real SOAR asset, ServiceNow API, credential or network is involved.

hints: Inspect running source and actual receipts before changing configuration.
Use the paused fixture clock deliberately; verify results through a separate view or query.

references.vendorVersion: Splunk security saved-search notable configuration family
references.purpose: Native action.notable parameters; bounded execution documented

checks.label: Failed response repaired; idempotent ticket retried and investigated

feedback.success: Verified operational state and retained evidence meet the lesson outcomes.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect actual source, activation, receipts and independent evidence.
